metadata.scenario: An upset client calls about an incorrect charge for a canceled appointment that was still billed. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I help you? Hi Margaret, this is Agnes Rodriguez. I'm calling about a billing issue I noticed on my account. I'm sorry to hear that, Agnes. Can you tell me more about the issue? Well, I was charged for an appointment that I canceled last week, and I thought that wouldn’t be billed. I see, that sounds frustrating. Let me check your account for you. Please hold for just a moment while I pull up your details. Sure, take your time. Thank you for your patience, Agnes. I see here that the appointment was indeed marked as canceled, but the charge was still applied. Exactly! I don’t understand why that happened. I was really counting on that charge being reversed. I can certainly help you with that. I’ll initiate a request for a refund right away. I appreciate that. How long will it take to process the refund? It typically takes 5 to 7 business days to process. I’ll follow up with you once it's completed. Thank you, I just don’t want to be billed again for something I didn't use. Absolutely, I understand your concern. Rest assured, I’ll make sure it’s resolved. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? Well, actually, I was wondering if there are any activities coming up that I could join. We do have some gardening activities planned in the next few weeks. Would you like me to schedule one for you? Oh, I would love that! I enjoy gardening. Great! Let me arrange for a caregiver to assist you with that. Thank you! That sounds wonderful. Of course, Agnes. I’ll book that and follow up on the refund as well. Perfect, I really appreciate your help with both issues. You're very welcome. If you have any other questions, don’t hesitate to call us. I will, thanks again, Margaret. Thank you, Agnes! Have a great day. Bye! Goodbye!
